arguments.prompt:
Create a professional native pixel-art game animation SOURCE ATLAS of Veteran Sergeant Sidonus. EXACT selected incarnation: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine (2011).

FIXED SOURCE APPEARANCE: Veteran Ultramarine, blue-and-gold non-Primaris power armour, grey-haired adult head and bionic eye, physical boltgun. FIXED WEAPON: Boltgun. FIXED ACTION: Rafale du bolter de Sidonus. Effect: damage; delivery: projectile.

Adult fictional character. Nonsexual practical game sprites. Clean detailed 16-bit pixel art, readable coherent three-quarter side view facing screen-RIGHT. Preserve the selected incarnation, never mix later gear or abilities. Same anatomical proportions and pixel scale in all poses; standing body stature calibrates to 220 game pixels (short dwarf 150, ordinary human 190, tall 205, massive Space Marine 220). Kneeling stays naturally shorter. Complete equipment and silhouette in each cell with generous empty transparent margins on every side. All swords, staff tips, bow tips, spear/hammer ends and feet completely visible.

STRICT LAYOUT: EXACTLY FORTY-EIGHT separate complete figures: EIGHT equal COLUMNS by SIX equal ROWS, regular 8 x 6 grid. Transparent background. No labels, letters, numbers, grid, panels, ground, scenery, cast shadow or other people. Each group of FOUR is one real FOUR-FRAME sequence: independently drawn different postures with visibly different feet/limbs/weapon angles. Never duplicate figures or invent additional phases. Keep identical scale across every cell. Leave generous clear alpha gutters, never overlap or clip.

ROW 1: columns 1-4 INTRO: four distinct quiet positions, approach with one small step, bring hands/equipment up, plant feet, settle in readiness with equipment held safely without attacking. Columns 5-8 OUTRO: lower hands/equipment, turn shoulders, step back, settle. No firing.

ROW 2: columns 1-4 ROUND VICTORY: restrained nod and brief acknowledgment gesture, lift head, shift weight, settle with equipment held safely without attacking. Columns 5-8 ROUND DEFEAT: lower shoulders, catch breath, slightly stoop, steady and recover. No attacks.

ROW 3: columns 1-4 FINISHING PRESENTATION: Shoulder physical boltgun, aim, brief recoil, recover; no sustained laser; four stages: ready, raise and aim the actual gun right, tiny ordinary muzzle flash attached to the actual muzzle in frame THREE only, recoil and recover. No beam, tracer or floating magic. Non-graphic solo demonstration, no opponent. Columns 5-8 MATCH VICTORY: four distinctive calm personal acknowledgment positions, different body and hand positions from round victory, settle. No attack.

ROW 4: columns 1-4 MATCH DEFEAT: slowly lower posture, crouch or lean with lowered head, steady balance, settle; intact unharmed character. Columns 5-8 SUPER: a separate newly drawn four-stage sequence of Shoulder physical boltgun, aim, brief recoil, recover; no sustained laser; four stages: ready, raise and aim the actual gun right, tiny ordinary muzzle flash attached to the actual muzzle in frame THREE only, recoil and recover. No beam, tracer or floating magic. Different actual drawings from finishing presentation, same source action and effect.

ROW 5: columns 1-4 IDLE: four subtle breathing and actual weight-transfer positions, visibly different shoulders/hands/feet, equipment held safely without attacking. Columns 5-8 RUN: four real locomotion stride poses, alternating planted leg and moving leg, with equipment held safely, same stature and source costume.

ROW 6: columns 1-4 ORDINARY ACTION: Shoulder physical boltgun, aim, brief recoil, recover; no sustained laser; four stages: ready, raise and aim the actual gun right, tiny ordinary muzzle flash attached to the actual muzzle in frame THREE only, recoil and recover. No beam, tracer or floating magic. Four new drawings distinct from super/finishing. Columns 5-8 HIT REACTION: four non-graphic flinch/guard/balance/recovery positions; intact character, no wounds.

Solo non-graphic animation acting only, no victim, enemy, blood, injury, corpse, severing, death or graphic violence. Intro/outro/victory/defeat/idle/run/hit are calm ordinary acting and never fire, strike, emit offensive effects or gain new powers. Supports stay zero-damage in ALL sequences including SUPER and FINISHING PRESENTATION. No generalized aura, no body glow, no borrowed power. Exact 48 figures, 8 columns x 6 rows, transparent background.
